generation_members.surface_form: MLIPs require substantial training data to learn the physics of the system, though this is becoming easier to meet as ab initio data becomes more plentiful and standardized.
U-MLIPs generally have low energy and force errors compared to their ab initio training data.
Some of the best-performing MLIPs are trained separately on energies and forces and are non-conservative, with forces not directly calculated by differentiating the PES.

tfidf_scope: Generation members only, within current snapshot and level
